messages:
Elaine: Heads up — BrightBridge (Mid-Mkt, renewal in 7d) dropped to ~12% MAU vs 78% baseline. Health score flagged: integrations + slow ingest. Thinking a short, focused save bundle rather than full playbook. Thoughts? :warning:
Marco: Oof. agree we don't have time for long cycles. Quick Qs: is billing on track? any active support tickets?
Elaine: billing ok, no unpaid invoices. Two support tickets: webhook failures + model latency spikes during batch imports. Both opened 2d ago.
Priya: I can run a 45m enablement + troubleshooting session Thurs 11am PT. Will walk them through ingestion config and a checklist. Could pair with a tailored quick-start doc.
Cassandra: I can push a hotfix to the webhook handler in ~2hrs and test on staging. Low-risk change. If it works we can offer it as immediate mitigation.
Marco: Proposed short "save bundle" (quick offer + ops support + enablement):
```
- 1 month pro-rated credit on renewal 
- Immediate webhook hotfix + 24h validation
- 45m enablement session (Priya) + recording and playbook
- 2-week success check-in cadence (CS + SE)
- Exec outreach if no usage bump by EoW
```
Elaine: I like that. also recommend a short, explicit ask for the customer: "join enablement + enable event ingest" — we need commitment to take the session.
Priya: I'll draft the invite + checklist and drop in their workspace. Template link: https://internal.redwood/docs/cs/save-bundle-template (draft).
Marco: I'll own the renewal side and exec note. If no traction by Friday EoD I'll escalate to VP of Accounts. Elaine, can you do a quick usage report snippet for the note? 2 bullets max.
Elaine: Yes — will send a 2-bullet summary and attach the ticket links.
Ops Bot: [alert] account_health: BrightBridge flagged (score 28) — triggered: usage_drop, recent_tickets.
Cassandra: Hotfix deployed to staging, ran smoke tests, logs look clean. Pushing to prod in 30m pending Priya/CS greenlight. :rocket:
Priya: Greenlighted if we pair with live session notes and rollback plan. I'll be on the 30m window to verify.
Marco: Nice — plan timeline: hotfix deploy today -> enablement Thurs -> 1wk check-in next Thurs -> renewal review in 7d.
Elaine: Action items:
- Cassandra: prod rollout + validation (today)
- Priya: session invite + checklist + recording setup (today)
- Elaine: 2-bullet usage summary + ticket links for exec note (today)
- Marco: exec outreach if no uplift by Fri EoD
Please add any blockers. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll also capture one short customer quote prompt to surface product friction in the renewal note.
Marco: Thanks team. If usage upticks > 30% after session, we'll propose standard renewal with small concession. If not, open to negotiated downgrade path but let's exhaust the bundle first.
Elaine: I'll post a quick follow-up thread after the prod validate. Thanks all. :eyes:
